title: Italy's beauty retail chain Pinalli acquired by Borletti Group
summary: The investment firm Borletti, which owns the Lafarmacia pharmacy chain (Hippocrates Holding) and fashion brands including True Religion, Moose Knuckles, and Twinset, has acquired Italian perfume retailer Pinalli (www.pinalli.it) from private equity firm H.I.G. Capital. Financial terms were not disclosed.
